source.control: C uses the exact A executable and store.

scope: Diagnose the historical warm regex regression. No engine repair or current-main latency claim.
method: Eight symmetric rounds in each variant order, whole-server user counters, paired round geometric means and 10000 bootstrap resamples with seed 733.
measurement_contract: All TSV and timed native answers agree. Plans agree after removing timeMs and consistently renaming random aggregate variables. Intervals with new uncounted threads are rejected and retried. Accepted counters have equal enabled and running time.
